opening.argument: The presentation directly links investing money in OneCoin and joining its mining community with substantial financial gain, promising viewers they will be “laughing all the way to the bank in a year or two.” It promotes OneCoin as a way to profit through enrollment, then predicts that its price will “truly explode” and that owners will experience unprecedented wealth. The appeal extends beyond appreciation: viewers are told they may benefit financially and possibly retire within a few years. Together, these claims use investment and prospective ownership to promise extraordinary profits and wealth.
